annotation.title_clean: Se realizó el encuentro “Oportunidades y desafíos en Inteligencia Artificial”
annotation.title_en: The meeting "Opportunities and Challenges in Artificial Intelligence" was held
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agencia I+D+i / Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (Argentina)
annotation.summary_en: Argentine government news item reporting a workshop on AI opportunities and challenges, organised by the Science Ministry, Agencia I+D+i and the IDB. It highlights a US$35 million IDB-backed AI programme, public-private consortia, and sector working groups (agro, bioinformatics, logistics, mining). No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: IDB agreement of US$35 million to invest in AI across agriculture, medical equipment, industry and education
Agencia I+D+i to move toward an integrated AI programme
National CTI Plan 2030 includes AI as a pillar
Working groups identified barriers: public-private-academic articulation, scarce skilled talent, data infrastructure and ethical responsibility
